Rotational equivariance gives F=(R(r),θ+ψ(r)); Jacobian sinh R R′/sinh r=k integrates cosh R=k cosh r+C, and R(ε)=acosh(k cosh ε) forces C=0. Conformal cylinder y=log tanh(r/2), x=θ yields derivative [[1,s],[0,q]], s=sinh r ψ′ and q=k sinh²r/(k²cosh²r−1), with q∈(0,1), q′>0, q_min=q(ε). Since first column has length 1 and determinant q, K≥1/q≥1/q(ε), attained by radial map. Trace/determinant identity K+1/K=(1+s²+q²)/q gives iff inequality s²≤(K0−q)(q−1/K0), including boundary; strict positive interior permits small compact twists, yielding nonunique minimizers. Unrestricted conformal cylinder modulus bound K≥Δy/ΔY is attained by affine cylinder interpolation matching pointwise boundary, and q increasing yields strict 1<K_free<K_area. As ε→0 at fixed k,b, q(ε)∼kε²/(k²−1), Δy∼log(1/ε), ΔY→L(k,b)>0, verifying inverse-square and logarithmic scales. Matched k=1+cε² has radial cosh expansion giving K_area→1+2c and K_free→1 (c=0 exactly identity). No claims outside equivariance/J=k, no finite sample substituted for exact identities.
